default.description: Baseline capabilities available on every platform.

desktop-only.description: Global shortcut and the updater are desktop only. `tauri-plugin-updater` declares `ios: none, android: none`, and mobile updates ship through TestFlight and Play, so a mobile build must not see this permission — which is why it is here rather than in `default.json`.

mobile-only.description: Haptics, push receive and the background scheduler are mobile only.
